_note: GENERIC EXAMPLE — copy this file to data/availability.json (gitignored) and edit that copy with your real schedule. When data/availability.json exists it wins; this packaged file is just a safe, working default.
_timezone_note: The agent parses times in this timezone and always shows proposed slots in both PT and ET.
fun_time_priority: Protect at least two personal/fun blocks each week — treat booking fun as real work.

google._note: Used only when Google Calendar is connected. Conflicts are checked across ALL calendars of ALL connected accounts EXCEPT those in exclude_calendars. default_booking_account = which Google account calls are booked into (its email; empty = first connected account). default_booking_calendar 'primary' = that account's main calendar; replace with a calendar id (from `python -m second_me.connect_google`) to book elsewhere.
google._exclude_note: Calendars to IGNORE when checking for conflicts (busy events on these never block a call slot). Match by calendar name or id; applies across all accounts.
